_comment: Fictional posts served by fake-mastodon.py for the feed's search columns. All people, handles and instances are made up.

coffee.content: Cold mornings mean the first pour-over of the day tastes twice as good. #coffee
New single origin on the bar today: washed Ethiopian, all jasmine and lemon. Come say hi. #coffee
Finally dialled in the new grinder. Turns out I was grinding far too fine for the last month. #coffee #homebarista
Rainy afternoon, a long novel and a flask of #coffee. That is the whole plan.
Ride report: 40km, two hills, one excellent flat white at the halfway stop. #coffee

latte art.content: Latte art practice, day 14. The tulip has three layers now and only one of them is wobbly.
Saturday latte art workshop has two spaces left. Milk, cups and patience provided.
Asked for oat milk and got a perfect rosetta. Whoever is on the bar at the harbour cafe this morning: thank you.
Hot take: latte art matters less than temperature. A beautiful swan on scalded milk is still scalded milk.
My kid drew latte art on paper for me this morning. Best heart I have seen all week.
